questions.qtext: The diameter of a sphere is decreased by 25%. By what percentage does its curved surface area decrease?
questions.solution:
(c)
If the diameter decreases by 25%, the radius also decreases by 25%.
So the new radius = 75% of the old radius = 0.75r
Curved surface area is proportional to the square of the radius : (0.75)2 = 0.5625
This means the new area is 56.25% of the original area
So, the decrease = 100 – 56.25 = 43.75%
Therefore, the curved surface area decreases by 43.75%.

questions.qtext: Both creep resistance and tensile strength of a metal can be enhanced by
questions.solution:
(c)
The strength and hardness in some metal alloys may be enhanced by the presence of extremely
small and uniformly dispersed particles within the original phase matrix by the means of dispersion
hardening. In this, dispersoids are introduced as insoluble particles as second phase particle.
Second phase particles in the form of very small uniformly distributed particles are added to the
matrix. These will block dislocation motion extremely well and strengthen the metal. Creep
resistance is also improved by the presence of finely dispersed intermetallic precipitates which
are stable at high temperature. Dispersoids resist the movement of dislocations that causes high
temperature creep.
